name: Private professional community operations
replacement_reason: Remove cross-lane near-duplicate; fresh complete SaaS hypothesis, not a novelty or validation claim.
distinct_record_boundary: Owns discussions, moderation cases and editorial knowledge lifecycle, not member dues or association governance.
penalty_reason: Low base wedge/feasibility/cost already incorporate the observed counterarguments; avoid a second deduction for the same risks. Independent reviewer owns final decision.
strongest_counterargument: Discourse has a free hosted tier and mature community functionality; Circle combines community, moderation and member tools at USD 89/month annually. Discussion-to-knowledge curation may be a configuration or plugin rather than an independent business.
